title: AI for Clinical Documentation
subtitle: Use AI assistants to draft clearer notes, discharge summaries and referral letters — without compromising privacy or accuracy.
description: Learn how AI tools can support (not replace) clinical documentation: structuring notes, drafting discharge summaries and referral letters from de-identified information, creating templates, and checking quality. The course places strong emphasis on data protection, institutional approval and clinician responsibility.
audience: Doctors and nurses who write notes, summaries and letters
Allied health professionals who document assessments
outcomes: Understand where AI can and cannot help with documentation
Create reusable documentation templates with AI
Draft letters and summaries from de-identified information
Apply a documentation quality checklist to AI-assisted drafts
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with any AI chat assistant is helpful but not required

modules.title: Templates and structure
modules.description: Designing reusable note and letter templates.
